description: Read-only ERP batch administration evals for dv-admin. Tests cover listing, local filtering, output, and refusal of unsupported retry or bulk-mutation verbs.
defaultAssertions: PRIORITY_2: FIRST_ATTEMPT: Agent used only the supported ERP batch list surface or refused unsupported mutation without fabricated verbs or avoidable retries.
PRIORITY_2: Every executed dataverse CLI command carries --context with app, skill=dv-admin, and agent attribution.

tests.prompt: Show me the latest Finance and Operations batch jobs in USMF, newest first, with the full fields available for scripting.
tests.expected_response: The agent directly uses dataverse erp batch list --company USMF --json. It relies on the command's newest-first ordering and reports actual returned jobs or the valid no-results outcome.
tests.description: List executing ERP batch jobs for one legal entity.
assertions: PRIORITY_1: The trajectory uses dataverse erp batch list --company USMF --json.

PRIORITY_1: OUTCOME: the response is grounded in returned batch results and includes the available RecId, description, status, company, timestamps, and executing user, or accurately reports No batch jobs found.
PRIORITY_1: The agent does not query BatchJobs with the Python SDK or use a fabricated watch/show command.

tests.prompt: Show the latest 50 Finance and Operations batch jobs as JSON and highlight any returned jobs whose status is Error and whose description contains posting.
tests.expected_response: The agent uses dataverse erp batch list --top 50 --json and filters only the returned payload locally for Error plus a case-insensitive posting substring. This avoids environment-specific server failures currently observed for --status and --caption while still using the dedicated batch surface.
tests.description: Filter failed ERP batch jobs by caption.
assertions: PRIORITY_1: The trajectory uses dataverse erp batch list --top 50 --json without the environment-sensitive --status or --caption server filters.
PRIORITY_1: It filters the returned JSON locally for Status equal to Error and a case-insensitive posting substring in JobDescription.
PRIORITY_1: OUTCOME: results are grounded in the command output, including an accurate no-results response when applicable.

tests.prompt: Does the supported Finance and Operations batch CLI have a retry-all-failed or watch command? Explain the supported alternative without running commands, retrying jobs, cancelling jobs, or changing anything.
tests.expected_response: The agent explains that the dedicated ERP batch surface supports list and cancel, not retry-all/watch. It suggests inspecting jobs with list and using supported F&O UI/admin workflows for retry, with separate confirmation for any cancellation.
tests.description: Reject invented ERP batch retry/watch verbs without mutations.
assertions: PRIORITY_1: The response identifies list and cancel as the supported ERP batch verbs and does not present retry-all-failed, retry, watch, or show as supported CLI verbs.
PRIORITY_1: The alternative uses batch listing for inspection and supported F&O UI/admin workflows for retry; cancellation is not a retry substitute.
PRIORITY_1: No environment calls or local file writes occur; skill/reference reads are allowed.
